d: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an intimate relationship with a second employee, according to two people familiar with the matter, Reuters reported. The revelation follows two other extramarital affairs that led to his resignation on Thursday. The two women identified are Alice Huang, whom US intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care. The latest disclosure adds another twist to the controversy surrounding Huang's departure from the technology giant. The revelations have raised fresh questions about the circumstances…
